Hi Elena / Tom — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Success criteria (tentative) — you mentioned these high-level goals during the call: 
   - 95th percentile token latency < 350ms for common inference route (summary endpoint)
   - End-to-end accuracy (F1) on your labeling set > 0.82 for entity extraction use case
   - Reduction in average inference cost per 1k requests by >= 30% vs current stack

2) Stakeholders / owners we heard: 
   - Elena Ruiz: project sponsor / PO for data & labels
   - Tom Baxter: infrastructure lead (procurement & cloud network)
   - Redwood owners: Dylan Brooks (engg contact), Marissa Cole (CS / success & ops)

3) Proposed POC schedule (high level) — draft for discussion: 
   - Kickoff: week of Jun 21 (1.5 hr operational + technical alignment)
   - Week 1: baseline telemetry & dataset ingestion (Redwood assists with converter script)
   - Weeks 2-3: model tuning + quantization profile experiments; weekly check-ins on Fridays
   - Week 4: final readout, acceptance testing, and handoff docs

4) Immediate asks from Evergreen: 
   - Shared sample dataset (anonymized) + small labeling guide by Jun 18
   - Confirmation on preferred kickoff date (options: Jun 22 or Jun 23)

I've attached a one-page RACI and a draft SOW for review (stubs below). If that's aligned I'll lock the kickoff and loop procurement for billing/PO.

Hi Dylan — thanks for the clear recap. This aligns with our internal priorities. A few clarifications and a tweak on success criteria:

- Latency: 350ms 95th is acceptable, but can we add an SLO target for 50th percentile < 120ms? That will be our end-user expectation.
- Accuracy: we'll run a small holdout set (3k labeled examples) — target F1 > 0.82 as you noted.
- Cost: instead of % reduction, can you provide an estimate of expected $/1k requests under your default config? We need rough numbers to evaluate against our forecast.

Owners confirmed on our side: I will be primary PO and Tom will handle procurement/networking. I'll have a legal/compliance contact join for any questions about data residency — will introduce if needed.

We can send the anonymized sample by Jun 18. Kickoff date: Jun 23 works best for our engineering team. Can you confirm availability?

Cheers,
